admissibility_policies.rule: Static, profile or correctness evidence cited for an occupancy/VGPR claim must come from the exact production template instantiation; synthetic or mismatched instantiations are refused.
A decode claim requires an exact phase command with generated tokens > 0 (never -n 0) and a capture window overlapping decode.
A negative static scan is admissible only with a resolved tool, exact argv, exit status 0 and unsuppressed stderr; missing- or failed-tool silence is refused.
Q4_K MMQ work cannot carry performance ranking until forced-MMQ baseline correctness is clean; the frozen stock baseline (18/43) is refused as a ranking anchor.
Q8_0 MMVQ is already integer-native (dp4a); proposals premised on hiding or fusing per-element FP dequantization are refused. Distinct Q8_1 reuse/caching/fusion mechanisms remain admissible.

No IQ-format role is ROCm0 serving-resident: IQ work may claim only latent/diagnostic value; a live-payoff claim is refused until a registry transition makes an IQ GGUF serving-resident (then reopen and reprice).
